decisions.reason: The Magento shop template is adjacent to the core hosting business but comparatively niche and maintenance-intensive, so with no later prominence we would redeploy resources to stronger platform and service offerings.
A responsive website template fits the customer base but is relatively commoditized and less strategic than managed hosting, support, and tools, so we would phase it out.
The software version management tool directly supports the firm's technical administration and automation focus, so it remains a good fit with the company's R&D-led platform strategy.
Scalable hosting for agencies is very close to the established offer and was positioned as a flagship direction, making continuation the natural choice in a growing market.
